idleSub: Haereere. Ka kimi ngā huatau i a koe.
pausedSub: Pāwhiri, pēhia rānei a Enter hei haere tonu.
editingSub: Ka tāmutu te kēmu i a koe e whakatika ana.
emptyTitle: Kāore anō he mea hei tākaro
emptySub: Tāpirihia he ihirangi ki tēnei kēmu kia taea ai te tākaro.
copyNote: Kua tāruatia. Whakapiria ki te wāhi e hiahia ana koe.
copyFail: Kua tīpakohia te kuputuhi. Tāruatia ki te Ctrl, Cmd rānei + C.
stageLabel: Kēmu ao tuwhera. Haereere me te kiripuaki. Ka wero ngā huatau i a koe ki ngā pātai.
stageHow: Hīkoi ki ngā pātene pere, ki W A S D rānei. Pēhia a N hei hīkoi ki te whare e whai ake nei. Ina puta mai tētahi huatau, pēhia te 1 ki te 4, a Tab me Enter rānei hei whakahoki. Pēhia a Tab hei haere tonu. Kei raro hoki i Pānuitia kāore e tākaro te kuputuhi katoa.
hintKeys: Ngā pere, WASD rānei hei hīkoi. N mō te whare e whai ake nei.
hintTouch: Pā ki te mahere, whakamahia rānei te papa
nextConcept: Te whare e whai ake nei
opensNew: ka tuwhera i tētahi ripa hou
guideText: Haereere. Ka kimi ngā huatau i a koe, ka patuki rānei ki tētahi whare raka kia tūtaki ki tētahi.
defeated: Kua hinga! E haere ana ki tōna whare.
knockedOut: Kua whati! Kua hoki whakamuri. Kua hoki mai ō ngākau, nā reira whakamātauria anō.
recapFirst: I tika i te whakamātau tuatahi
recapNone: Kāore. Kāore he mea hei arotake.
